name: The Horseman's Seal is equippable at level 60 (#10228)
contract: item_template entry 49123 (The Horseman's Seal, Headless Horseman loot) had RequiredLevel 80 even though #8361 lowered the Headless Horseman himself (23682) to level 63 so level-60 players could reach him. CanEquipItem/CanUseItem reject equipping an item whose RequiredLevel exceeds the player's level; before this fix a level-60 player who looted 49123 could never wear it. The fix lowers RequiredLevel to 60.

steps.label: Equip it in a finger slot
